influences.name: John Fahey
influences.context: I was playing acoustic guitars again seriously for the first time in ages so I guess that really took me back to certain things I listened to when I was much younger, when I was predominately an acoustic guitar player – whether it was John Fahey or Leo Kottke or David Crosby, Joni Mitchell, Neil Young, Velvet Underground and Reverend Gary Davis – all kinds of people that were working with open guitar tunings.

influences.name: Leonard Cohen
influences.context: Lee Ronaldo stated that for these songs he pulled inspiration from the likes of Neil Young, Joni Mitchell and Leonard Cohen.

influences.name: His mother
influences.context: My mom played classical piano, so there was always a piano and someone making music in the house. She was also a seamstress and there is a definite creative process there as well. I learned how to sew at an early age.
